meta.name: Observatory — luminous fiber brain
meta.description: Phase-0 proposal from four user-provided still images. Image 4 is the proposed primary reference. Scene colors are visual estimates, not measured anchor values. UI tokens are inherited from Observatory; motion and interaction are proposed because still images do not demonstrate behavior. No new renderer has been implemented.

primary.role: Fine near-field fibers and restrained brain contour; proposed from image 4

neutral.usage: Dark scene and existing Observatory surfaces; bright neutral text stays in DOM

typography.font_style_notes: Local system fonts from Observatory, not inferred from stock-image watermarks or background typography.

spacing.section_rhythm: Preserve current dashboard spacing; keep scene controls close to their viewport and explanations in the inspector.

components.button_style: Existing mint primary and compact ghost buttons; toggle states visibly selected

components.component_notes: Add only direct controls for orbit/reset, standard views, selected unit, region isolation, shell visibility and playback; preserve existing model meanings.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A transparent brain made of fine living pathways, not a solid tissue specimen

visual_language.ornamentation: Only meaning-bearing fibers, nodes and signal highlights
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Dark negative space around a clearly bounded brain silhouette
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: One dominant 3D brain; supporting controls and inspector remain quieter
visual_language.focal_strategy: Selected neuron or active path inside a readable whole
visual_language.contrast_level: High local contrast on a small number of luminous elements
visual_language.texture_usage: Fine curved fibers, not an opaque photo texture or background noise

composition.hierarchy_method: Spatial depth and selected-path contrast within the established dashboard hierarchy
composition.flow_direction: Whole brain to selected unit to traced pathway
composition.grouping_strategy: Fibers form legible bundles; computational regions remain distinct from anatomical lobes
composition.negative_space_role: Preserves silhouette, depth and room for readable inspection

background_effects.description: Opaque dark scene ground; no animated background

particle_systems.description: Model-addressable nodes and sparse signal packets, not decorative floating particles

post_processing: Restrained selective glow, to be evaluated against anchors

svg_animations.description: Existing static UI icons may remain; SVG is not the primary spatial scene

visual_effects.composite_notes: The still references show a luminous fiber aesthetic but cannot prove volumetric implementation or motion. Actual orbit, perspective, depth occlusion and ID-consistent selection must be demonstrated in the future 3D prototype. Decorative anatomical fibers, sample model edges and measured telemetry must stay distinguishable. The latest image changes the proposed dominant scene from cyan-neon to delicate blue-white fibers and restrained gold. This file records a plan, not a completed implementation or validated performance result.
